# Test persona: Morgan Sample

Morgan Sample is an invented person for tests and CI. Every fact here is made
up: the name, employers, schools, contact details and dates. The email domain
is `example.com` and the phone number is in the fictional 555-01xx range.
Nothing in this directory describes any real person; never add real data here.

- `profile.json`: the facts the agent knows about the persona.
- `resume.md`: the persona's fake resume.
